description: This is a Java entity class representing a 'Handover' record within a project management system. It models the data structure for project handovers, including fields like project reference, date, received by, and notes. It uses Jakarta Persistence annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Handover
classes.description: Entity class for storing information about project handovers including project reference, date, receiver, and notes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the handover record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the handover record.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates this handover with a specific Project.

methods.name: getHandoverDate
methods.description: Returns the date on which the handover occurred.

methods.name: setHandoverDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the handover.

methods.name: getReceivedBy
methods.description: Returns the name of the person who received the handover.

methods.name: setReceivedBy
methods.description: Sets the name of the person who received the handover.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Returns additional notes related to the handover.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Adds notes related to the handover.
